questions.question: What is the type of { (a: Int, b: Int) in a + b }?
questions.why: It takes two Int values and returns their sum, an Int.

questions.question: What does [1, 2, 3].map { $0 * 10 } give?
questions.why: map transforms each item and returns a new array.

questions.question: Which method keeps only some items?
questions.why: filter keeps the items for which the closure returns true.

questions.question: Why does each call to a makeCounter() function get its own count?

answers.text: Each call creates a new variable, which its own closure captures
Swift resets the count every time

questions.why: Captured variables live as long as the closure that captured them.
